def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(g) if row and row[0] != 0 and all(v == row[0] for v in row)]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if g[0][c] != 0 and all(g[r][c] == g[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    rb = [0] + [r + 1 for r in sep_rows]  # starts after horizontal dividers
    re = sep_rows + [h]                   # ends before horizontal dividers
    cb = [0] + [c + 1 for c in sep_cols]
    ce = sep_cols + [w]
    # Pair each interval by its start/end; leading boundaries are handled explicitly.
    rows = [(0, sep_rows[0])] if sep_rows else [(0, h)]
    rows += [(sep_rows[i] + 1, sep_rows[i+1]) for i in range(len(sep_rows)-1)]
    if sep_rows: rows.append((sep_rows[-1] + 1, h))
    cols = [(0, sep_cols[0])] if sep_cols else [(0, w)]
    cols += [(sep_cols[i] + 1, sep_cols[i+1]) for i in range(len(sep_cols)-1)]
    if sep_cols: cols.append((sep_cols[-1] + 1, w))
    # Discard incomplete trailing strips; puzzle panels are equal-sized.
    if rows:
        rh = max(b-a for a,b in rows)
        rows = [(a,b) for a,b in rows if b-a == rh]
    if cols:
        cw = max(b-a for a,b in cols)
        cols = [(a,b) for a,b in cols if b-a == cw]

    def get(i, j):
        a,b=rows[i]; c,d=cols[j]
        return {(r-a, x-c, g[r][x]) for r in range(a,b) for x in range(c,d) if g[r][x] != 0}
    def reflect(p, axis):
        return {( (rh-1-r if axis == 'v' else r), (cw-1-c if axis == 'h' else c), col) for r,c,col in p}
    def equiv(p,q):
        return any(reflect(p,ax)==q for ax in ('h','v','hv','none'))
    nr,nc=len(rows),len(cols)
    for i in range(nr-1):
        for j in range(nc-1):
            coords=[(i,j),(i,j+1),(i+1,j),(i+1,j+1)]
            pats=[get(a,b) for a,b in coords]
            empty=[k for k,p in enumerate(pats) if not p]
            if len(empty)!=1: continue
            occupied=[p for p in pats if p]
            colors=[{z[2] for z in p} for p in occupied]
            if not all(len(x)==1 for x in colors) or len({next(iter(x)) for x in colors})!=1: continue
            if not all(equiv(occupied[0],p) for p in occupied[1:]): continue
            k=empty[0]; a,b=coords[k]
            # Reflect the adjacent cell across the missing horizontal or vertical edge.
            if k in (0,2): # missing left; use right neighbor
                src=pats[k+1] if k==0 else pats[k+1]
                new=reflect(src,'h')
            elif k in (1,3): # missing right; use left neighbor
                src=pats[k-1]
                new=reflect(src,'h')
            # If horizontal neighbor unavailable, use the vertical neighbor instead.
            if not new:
                continue
            ra,rb=rows[a]; ca,cb=cols[b]
            for r,c,col in new:
                g[ra+r][ca+c]=col
    return g
